- 19 sections (unusual, some with names like /4, /19, /31, etc. — these look like sections with names that are offsets into the string table, typical of COFF object files, but in a PE this is unusual — could be a Delphi or some other compiler, or manually crafted)
- TLS callbacks present
- Imports from KERNEL32 and msvcrt
- No exports
- Console subsystem

Interesting imports: OpenProcess, VirtualProtect, VirtualQuery, GetProcAddress, GetModuleHandleA, TlsGetValue, Sleep, WaitForSingleObject...

The section names /4, /19, /31 etc. are typical when a section name is longer than 8 bytes and stored in the string table — common in COFF .obj files. But for executables, the string table is usually stripped. This might indicate the binary was created in an unusual way. Actually, MinGW can produce this when sections have long names.
